battle.name: 法國入侵阿爾及利亞
battle.theater: 阿爾及爾海岸、斯泰勒利與皇帝堡
battle.brief: 一八三〇年六月十四日法軍在斯迪費魯什登陸，六月二十四日再與西迪哈萊夫守軍交戰，七月四日攻城砲列攻破皇帝堡、海軍同時砲擊海牆，五日侯賽因德伊在厄爾比亞爾簽下投降書，九日法軍入城。野砲在此役既是登陸後唯一能立刻展開的常備砲火，也證明拆得開、帶得走的輕砲打不穿城牆。

kit.name: 野砲
kit.history: 能拆成幾件馬車拉走的砲。它讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。

countries: 交戰的一方是復辟王朝末期、尚未被七月革命推翻的法國王國。一八三〇年四月十一日，國王沙爾十世頒布敕令，任命陸軍大臣兼遠征軍總司令布爾蒙伯爵為北非遠征總司令，指派海軍中將杜佩雷率艦隊配合；法方的編制是正規陸軍三萬七千五百零七人、軍馬四千五百一十二匹，海軍二萬七千人、一百零二艘軍艦，並有西班牙、薩丁尼亞、俄國、奧地利與美國的觀察員隨軍。另一方是受奧斯曼宗主權庇護的阿爾及爾攝政王國：德伊侯賽因掌政，軍權分授奧蘭、康斯坦丁與提特里三個貝伊，其中康斯坦丁貝伊艾哈邁德是野戰主力，哈桑阿加、本扎穆恩分領城防與近衛，攝政王依賴耶尼恰里民兵以及各地部族提供的騎兵與射手，東部的卡比利亞部族則站在法國一方。攝政王曾向摩洛哥阿方王朝與突尼斯攝政王求援，兩者都拒絕，只有的黎波里的貝伊響應聖戰號召。外交上，英國因懼怕法國染指地中海霸權而反對遠征，但英國以直布羅陀與馬耳他為基地，並未出兵干涉；真正改變局勢的卻是巴黎——一八三〇年七月革命在本土爆發，八月二日沙爾十世退位，七月王朝接手這場征服，把它從王朝的宣傳勝利變成國家的長線政策。
countriesEn: One party was the Kingdom of France under the late Bourbon Restoration, before the July Revolution had swept it away. On 11 April 1830 the king, Charles X, issued the ordinance that appointed the war minister and commander-in-chief of the expedition, Count de Bourmont, to command the North African expedition, and assigned a vice-admiral, Duperré, with the fleet to cooperate; the French order of battle was thirty-seven thousand five hundred and seven men of the regular army with four thousand five hundred and twelve horses, twenty-seven thousand sailors and one hundred and two warships, and observers from Spain, Sardinia, Russia, Austria and the United States travelled with the force. Against them stood the Regency of Algiers, sheltered by the suzerainty of the Ottoman Empire: the Dey Hussein held the government, and military authority was parcelled out to the beys of Oran, Constantine and Titteri, of whom Ahmed Bey of Constantine was the main field force, while Hassan Agha and Ben Zamoun held the city defences and the household troops; the Dey relied on the janissary militia and on horsemen and musketeers supplied by the tribes, and the Kabyle clans of the eastern districts stood on the French side. The Dey asked the Alaouite Sultanate of Morocco and the Regency of Tunis for help and was refused by both; only the Bey of Tripoli answered the call to a holy war. In diplomatic terms Britain opposed the expedition because it feared French encroachment on its Mediterranean hegemony, but Britain, based at Gibraltar and Malta, did not intervene militarily. What really changed the situation was Paris: the July Revolution broke out at home, Charles X abdicated on 2 August 1830, and the July Monarchy inherited the conquest, turning it from a royal propaganda triumph into a long-term policy of the state.
people: 法方最高指揮是布爾蒙伯爵路易－奧古斯特－德－蓋訥－德－布爾蒙：一八三〇年四月十一日他以陸軍大臣身分被敕令任命為遠征軍總司令，此時他尚未取得元帥軍銜，征服之後才封元帥。參謀長是德普雷將軍，步兵序列由貝爾蒂茲納男爵領第一師，炮兵歸拉希特子爵指揮，工兵歸瓦拉澤將軍，騎兵歸杜巴里上校。七月三日各攻城砲列全部就位後，四日清晨四點下令所有砲列同時開火、對射四小時的正是拉希特。艦隊旗艦赫庫爾號由維拉雷・德・若伊厄斯上校率領，總指揮杜佩雷坐鎮主力。參戰的年輕軍官名單裡有日後封元帥的巴雷吉・伊利耶、麥克馬洪、馬尼安、佩利西耶與瓦揚坦，另有後來被稱為阿非利加三巨頭的杜維維耶、拉莫里西耶爾與尚加尼耶；輕步兵第二與第四團的團長弗雷謝維爾中校於一八三〇年七月二十一日在阿爾及爾病逝。背景人物同樣關鍵：一八〇八年受拿破崙派遣到阿爾及爾作間諜的工兵上尉布坦，留下了登陸點與迂迴路線的偵察圖；一八二七年奉陸軍大臣克萊蒙－托內爾之命在封鎖船隊上擬定進攻計畫的海軍上校科萊；以及批准遠征的沙爾十世與首席大臣波利尼亞克。阿爾及爾一方，德伊侯賽因把野戰軍交給易卜拉欣阿加指揮，隊中還有哈桑阿加與本扎穆恩；康斯坦丁貝伊艾哈邁德自告奮勇在最前線作戰，一八三〇年之後仍在內陸抵抗至一八三七年。
peopleEn: The highest command on the French side was Count Louis-Auguste-Victor de Ghaisne de Bourmont: on 11 April 1830 he was appointed commander-in-chief of the expedition by the ordinance of the war minister, and at that moment he did not yet hold the rank of marshal, which was conferred on him only after the conquest. The chief of staff was General Desprez; the infantry was led in the first division by Baron Berthezène, the artillery by the vicomte de La Hitte, the engineers by General Valazé and the cavalry by Colonel Dubarry. It was La Hitte who, on 3 July, once every siege battery had been emplaced, ordered all batteries to open fire together at four in the morning of the 4th and sustained four hours of answering fire. The flagship Hercule was commanded by Colonel Villaret de Joyeuse, while Duperré held the main body of the fleet. The list of young officers present includes five who would one day be made marshals of France, Baraguey d'Hilliers, Mac Mahon, Magnan, Pélissier and Vaillant, together with three later called the great Africans, Duvivier, Lamoricière and Changarnier; Colonel Frescheville, colonel of the second and fourth light infantry regiments, died of illness at Algiers on 21 July 1830. The background figures matter just as much: the engineer captain Boutin, sent by Napoleon to Algiers as a spy in 1808, left behind his survey of the landing place and the flanking route; the naval captain Collet, who drew up the offensive plan in 1827 on the orders of the war minister Clermont-Tonnerre while commanding the blockade station; and King Charles X and his chief minister Polignac, who authorised the expedition. On the Algerian side the Dey Hussein entrusted the field army to Ibrahim Agha, with Hassan Agha and Ben Zamoun beside him, and Ahmed Bey of Constantine volunteered for the hardest fighting in the front rank and went on resisting in the interior until 1837.
kits: 卡面這門野砲是一張概念卡：一五五〇年前後的歐洲野砲已能拆成砲身、炮架同前車，幾件馬車就能拉走，讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。一八三〇年的法軍把這個概念推到制度化的盡頭，輕野砲統一為青銅前裝滑膛的四磅砲與六磅砲，砲身架在兩輪炮架上，前車收存備砲與備彈，一門砲配一組固定炮手與一隊曳馬，射前定好裝藥量、射程與射界，砲後跟隨裝藥車與備彈車列。遠征軍的炮兵共二千三百二十七人、一千三百零九匹馬，分成裝馬砲兵連、專供圍城的散馬砲兵連（四十名軍官、一千名炮手）、架橋兵、工兵與炮兵勤務隊；二、三、四、七、九各炮兵團各出第四、第十、第十一連，海軍炮兵另有一至四連。真正打開城門的卻不是這類輕砲：六月十九日法軍在斯泰勒利反擊成功、繳了攝政王的野砲與營地，但攻城重砲遲遲未到，法軍便在灘頭堡等了兩個星期，直到七月三日各攻城砲列全部就位，攻堡火力全靠隨艦運來的八十三門攻城重砲同海軍的攻城砲列。攝政王一方的火砲是奧斯曼系統：城牆與海岸砲臺上的舊青銅砲，口徑雜亂、備彈難配，十九日在斯泰勒利被繳的那批野砲正是這一套。步兵用一八一一年式燧發滑膛步槍，口徑十七毫米，配刺刀，輕步兵用卡賓槍；工兵有工兵連、坑道連與架橋兵，攻城靠掘壕、堆堡、扶正砲位同填壕。全軍裝備靠船運：四百五十三艘（另一份編制記為六百七十五艘）船隻載人載馬載砲，一百零二艘軍艦、十一艘主力艦同二十四艘巡防艦在岸外護航；海運與市集供應，才是這場戰爭真正的瓶頸。
kitsEn: The field gun on this card is a concept card. By about 1550 the European field piece could already be broken into barrel, carriage and limber, so that a few cartloads could take it along, and field warfare acquired for the first time a firepower that could be calculated. By 1830 the French had carried that concept to the end of institutionalisation: the light field pieces were standardised as bronze smoothbore four- and six-pounders, the barrel mounted on a two-wheeled carriage, the limber carrying the spare gun and reserve ammunition, each gun manned by a fixed gun crew and drawn by a team of horses, with charge, range and arc of fire laid down before the shot and the loading and reserve-ammunition wagons following behind. The expedition's artillery numbered two thousand three hundred and twenty-seven men and one thousand three hundred and nine horses, divided into mounted batteries, unmounted batteries serving the sieges (forty officers and one thousand gunners), pontonniers, engineer-artillerymen and artillery train: the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 7th and 9th artillery regiments each supplied their 4th, 10th and 11th batteries, and the marine artillery added its 1st to 4th batteries. What actually opened the gate was not any of these light pieces. On 19 June the French beat back the attack at Staouéli and captured the Regency's field guns and camp, but the heavy siege guns were slow to arrive, so the army sat on the bridgehead for a fortnight, until on 3 July every siege battery was emplaced and the assault on the fort rested entirely on the eighty-three heavy pieces shipped out with the fleet and on the naval siege train. The artillery of the Regency was an Ottoman system: old bronze guns on the walls and in the coastal batteries, of mixed calibres and with ammunition that did not match, and the field pieces captured at Staouéli on the 19th were of just that kind. The infantry carried the Model 1811 flintlock musket of seventeen millimetres bore with a bayonet, the light troops carbines; the engineers included sappers, a company of miners and pontonniers, and the siege was worked by trench, battery, gabion and traverse. The whole army's equipment came by sea: four hundred and fifty-three vessels (a separate composition table gives six hundred and seventy-five) carried men, horses and guns, while one hundred and two warships, eleven of them ships of the line and twenty-four frigates, stood guard off the coast. Sea transport and market supply, not the fighting, were the true bottleneck of this war.
tactics: 這場戰役的戰術要分兩段：登陸與野戰是一段，攻城是另一段，中間隔著一次關鍵的等待。六月十四日清晨，遠征軍在西迪費魯什登陸，數百艘登陸艇同時靠岸，法軍在數小時內建立灘頭堡，並以野砲連封鎖通往斯泰勒利的高地，攝政王的軍隊此時還沒有集結。六月十九日拂曉，攝政王的軍隊主動攻擊法軍陣地，法軍以步砲協同的散兵線反擊，數小時後把進攻打退，並繳了對方的野砲與斯泰勒利營地，法軍隨即進駐該營，把陣線向前推。之後法軍在灘頭堡停滯不動，等候運來的攻城重砲與糧秣；六月二十六日一場暴風把軍營與近岸船隊攪得狼藉，這段等待是全役最吃重的部分。真正的攻城自六月二十九日法軍在皇帝堡前出現起：三十日開挖壕溝，七月三日海軍砲擊阿爾及爾城牆並攻擊海岸砲臺，同日所有攻城砲列就位；七月四日清晨四點全部砲列同時開火，四小時對射之中城垛被打得沒有遮蔽，砲位大部被毀，堡內為燃燒彈與實心彈所毀；法軍下令打缺口時，守軍已放火焚燬堡內火藥，中央主塔當場爆炸，堡遂陷落。五日侯賽因德伊在厄爾比亞爾簽署投降書，九日法軍入城。整條戰術鏈條由兩件事決定：輕野砲能守灘頭、能在野戰中反擊，卻打不穿城牆；能打穿城牆的是攻城重砲與艦隊的攻城砲列，而在它們到位之前，法軍只能等。
tacticsEn: The tactics of this campaign fall into two parts, a landing and a field action on one side and a siege on the other, with a decisive wait between them. In the early hours of 14 June the expeditionary army landed at Sidi-Ferruch, several hundred boats coming ashore at once, established a bridgehead within a few hours and closed the heights leading to Staouéli with the field batteries, while the Regency's army had not yet gathered. At daybreak on 19 June the Regency's troops attacked the French position of their own accord; the French answered with a skirmish line supported by the field guns, drove the attack off after several hours, captured the enemy's guns and the camp of Staouéli, and then moved into that camp themselves, pushing the line forward. After that the army stood still on the bridgehead, waiting for the heavy guns and the supplies still to come by sea; a storm on 26 June threw the camp and the shipping near the shore into confusion, and that wait was the heaviest part of the whole operation. The siege proper began when the French came in sight of Fort de l'Empereur on 29 June: trenches were opened on the 30th, the fleet bombarded the walls of Algiers and attacked the coastal batteries on 3 July, and on the same day every siege battery was emplaced. At four in the morning of 4 July all batteries opened fire together, and in four hours of answering fire the parapets were stripped of cover, most gun positions were destroyed and the interior of the fort was devastated by incendiary and solid shot; when the order came to breach the wall, the defenders had already fired their magazines and the central tower blew up, and the fort fell. On the 5th Hussein Dey signed the capitulation at El Biar, and on the 9th the French entered the city. The whole chain of tactics is decided by two facts: the light field gun could hold a bridgehead and could win a field action, but it could not bite through a wall; what bit through the wall was the heavy siege train and the fleet's siege guns, and until those arrived the French could only wait.
data: 數字要分法軍與攝政王軍兩邊核對。法軍陸軍總計三萬七千五百零七人，其中軍官一千八百七十六人、士兵三萬五千六百三十一人，配軍馬四千五百一十二匹；步兵三萬零八百五十二人，一旅三千四百二十八人，一師一萬零二百八十四人，一八三〇年二月二十日陸軍部還決定把遠征各步兵營補到八百四十人。炮兵二千三百二十七人、一千三百零九匹馬；騎兵五百三十四人、五百零三匹馬，非洲獵騎兵團由第十三與第十七獵騎兵團各撥五個中隊組成；海軍二萬七千人、一百零二艘軍艦，其中主力艦十一艘、巡防艦二十四艘，旗艦赫庫爾號七十四門砲，另有海軍炮兵四連，隨艦共載八十三門攻城重砲。艦隊規模有兩種說法：遠征編制記四百五十三艘船，戰役記為六百七十五艘民用軍用船；五月十一日登船時是三萬七千人與四千人馬，五月二十五日自土倫起航，十三日抵達西迪費魯什，航行十九日。攝政王軍的數字分歧更大，估計三萬至五萬人，而德伊只調動了他能支配的一半兵力。損失方面，法軍記陣亡四百一十五人、受傷二千一百六十人，攝政王軍的軍人損失估計六百至一千五百人陣亡。時間上，六月十四日登陸至七月五日投降，前後二十一日；皇帝堡一役自六月二十九日望見堡影、三十日開挖壕溝到七月四日陷落，只有五日。距離上，攻城重砲與艦隊自遙遠泊地運來，故法軍在灘頭堡實際等了兩星期以上。卡面那門一五五〇年的野砲沒有可比的傷亡數字，它決定的是每個砲位能帶多少發藥、每發藥能走多遠，以及一次齊射能覆蓋多少長度的射界。
dataEn: The figures have to be checked separately for the French and for the Regency army. The French land force totalled thirty-seven thousand five hundred and seven men, of whom one thousand eight hundred and seventy-six were officers and thirty-five thousand six hundred and thirty-one were soldiers, with four thousand five hundred and twelve horses; the infantry numbered thirty thousand eight hundred and fifty-two, a brigade being three thousand four hundred and twenty-eight men and a division ten thousand two hundred and eighty-four, and on 20 February 1830 the war ministry decided that the infantry battalions assigned to the expedition should be brought up to eight hundred and forty men. The artillery was two thousand three hundred and twenty-seven men and one thousand three hundred and nine horses; the cavalry was five hundred and thirty-four men and five hundred and three horses, the Chasseurs d'Afrique being formed of five squadrons taken from each of the 13th and 17th regiments of light horse; the navy was twenty-seven thousand men and one hundred and two warships, of which eleven were ships of the line and twenty-four frigates, the flagship Hercule carrying seventy-four guns, with four batteries of marine artillery, and eighty-three heavy siege pieces were shipped with the fleet. Two figures are given for the size of the convoy: the composition table gives four hundred and fifty-three vessels, the campaign account six hundred and seventy-five civil and military ships; when the troops embarked on 11 May there were thirty-seven thousand men and four thousand horses, and the fleet sailed from Toulon on 25 May to reach Sidi-Ferruch on the 13th, nineteen days at sea. The numbers for the Regency army differ more widely, being estimated at thirty to fifty thousand men, while the Dey called up only half of what he could have summoned. As for losses: the French record four hundred and fifteen dead and two thousand one hundred and sixty wounded, and the military losses of the Regency are estimated at six hundred to fifteen hundred dead. In time, the landing on 14 June and the capitulation on 5 July are twenty-one days apart; the business of Fort de l'Empereur, from sighting it on 29 June and opening the trenches on the 30th to its fall on 4 July, took only five days. As for distance, the heavy guns and the fleet had to be brought from remote anchorages, so that the French in fact waited on the bridgehead for more than a fortnight. The field gun of 1550 on the card has no comparable casualty figure: what it decided was how many rounds each gun position could carry, how far each round would travel, and how much length of front a single salvo could cover.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最遠的一層是海權與私掠：十八世紀末到十九世紀初，阿爾及爾攝政王的私掠船在法國、西班牙、義大利沿岸橫行，一八〇一至一八〇五年美國先後打了兩場巴巴里戰爭，一八一六年英荷聯軍轟擊阿爾及爾，一八二四年皇家海軍再度封鎖港口；拿破崙早在一八〇八年便派工兵上尉布坦到阿爾及爾作間諜，畫下登陸點與迂迴路線，並建議動用三萬五千至四萬人，這份情報二十二年後被遠征軍原樣採用。中間的一層是商業糾紛：法國商人巴克里與布斯納赫在革命政府年代向攝政王的軍隊供應糧草，債務三十多年未清，侯賽因德伊要法國償還，爭到一八二七年四月三十日發生扇子事件，法國召回駐阿爾及爾領事，雙方斷交，法國海軍自一八二七年六月十五日起封鎖阿爾及爾港直到一八三〇年。最後一層是沙爾十世的政治處境：一八二七年十月十四日內閣會議已通過一項在阿爾及爾外海登陸的方案，卻因與奧斯曼關係緊張而擱置；一八二九年十月國王與首席大臣波利尼亞克決定在次年春天出兵，最遲不晚於四月十一日以敕令任命布爾蒙。這場遠征被當作一次愛國的懲罰性行動，用來洗刷王朝的旗幟；而它恰好趕在巴黎革命之前完成——法軍在阿爾及爾取得全勝的同時，法國本土的路障正在升起。
causeEn: There were three layers behind the fighting. The farthest is sea power and piracy: in the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries the privateers of the Regency of Algiers ranged along the coasts of France, Spain and Italy; the United States fought two Barbary Wars between 1801 and 1805; an Anglo-Dutch fleet bombarded Algiers in 1816; and the Royal Navy blockaded the port again in 1824. Napoleon had already sent the engineer captain Boutin to Algiers as a spy in 1808; he mapped the landing place and the flanking route and advised calling in thirty-five to forty thousand men, and twenty-two years later the expedition applied his work as it stood. The middle layer is a commercial quarrel: the French merchants Bacri and Busnach had supplied grain to the Regency's armies under the Revolutionary government, the debt went unsettled for more than thirty years, Hussein Dey demanded payment from France, the quarrel came to the affair of the fan on 30 April 1827, France recalled its consul at Algiers, the two sides broke off relations, and the French navy blockaded the port of Algiers from 15 June 1827 until 1830. The last layer is the political position of Charles X: a plan for landing outside Algiers had been approved by the council of ministers on 14 October 1827 and then shelved because of the tension with the Ottoman Empire; in October 1829 the king and his chief minister Polignac decided to send an army the following spring, and by 11 April at the latest an ordinance appointed Bourmont. The expedition was presented as a patriotic punitive expedition meant to refurbish the honours of the dynasty; and it happened to be completed just before the revolution in Paris, for while the French won outright at Algiers the barricades were already rising in France itself.
impact: 直接後果是法國在北非取得第一個陸地根據地，而與此同時王朝在本土垮台。征服的消息在七月革命之前傳回巴黎，成了保王派唯一的安慰；八月二日沙爾十世退位，七月王朝接手遠征，把阿爾及爾從一次懲罰性遠征變成長期征服，直到一八四七年才以阿卜杜勒卡迪爾的投降收場。制度上，一八三四年七月二十二日與八月十日的兩道敕令把這塊土地正式併入法國並設置軍政高官，攝政王原有的臣民被納入土著法的差別管治；同時從阿爾及爾本地人與土耳其兵中編成的祖阿夫兵與阿非利加軍，成為法國殖民軍的骨幹，日後名將布蓋約、瓦萊與拉莫里西耶爾都在這支隊伍裡起步，巴黎的阿爾及爾街至今留著這場戰役的名字。戰略與外交上，佔領阿爾及爾等於法國在地中海南方取得一個海軍基地，能牽制直布羅陀體系並保護馬賽與土倫的商路；此後一百年，法國在北非的影響沿著海岸與內陸推進，一八四八年第二共和國正式兼併阿爾及利亞，一八八一年法國在突尼斯的駐軍、十九世紀末在埃及與蘇伊士的動作，都是同一條地緣邏輯的延伸。而對英國而言，一個法國據點就站在通往印度的航路上，這正是英國在往後數十年裡始終提防法國涉入埃及的同一條地緣邏輯。
impactEn: The immediate result was that France gained its first land foothold in North Africa, and at the same moment the dynasty collapsed at home. The news of the conquest reached Paris before the July Revolution and was the one comfort left to the royalists; on 2 August Charles X abdicated, and the July Monarchy inherited the expedition, turning Algiers from a punitive raid into a long conquest that did not end until Abd al-Qadir's surrender in 1847. Institutionally, the ordinances of 22 July and 10 August 1834 incorporated the territory formally into France and set up its military and civil administration, while the former subjects of the Dey were placed under the discriminatory rule known as the indigénat; the Zouaves and the Army of Africa, raised from the men of Algiers and the Turkish soldiers, became the backbone of the French colonial army, and the future generals Bugeaud, Valée and Lamoricière all began their careers in it, while the rue d'Alger in Paris still carries the name of this campaign. Strategically and diplomatically, holding Algiers gave France a naval base in the southern Mediterranean, able to check the Gibraltar system and protect the trade of Marseille and Toulon; for a century afterwards French influence in North Africa advanced along the coast and into the interior, the Second Republic annexing Algeria formally in 1848, the French garrison in Tunisia in 1881 and the French moves in Egypt and at Suez in the late nineteenth century all following the same geographical logic. As for Britain, a French base stood directly on the road to India, and that was the same geographical logic that made British governments watch French moves in Egypt for decades afterwards.
result: 結果是法軍在二十一日內佔領阿爾及爾城，卻遠未佔領阿爾及爾。七月五日侯賽因德伊在厄爾比亞爾的拉希杜馬尼別墅簽署投降書，規定法軍進駐、攝政王退往布利達，攝政王保留對內陸的統治；七月九日法軍列隊入城，內陸仍在各貝伊與部族手中，康斯坦丁貝伊艾哈邁德更一直抵抗到一八三七年。城門打開的過程並不光彩：守軍棄堡時焚毀火藥，堡內中央主塔爆炸，堡後還有攝政王付賞金收購的割下人頭堆成的小山。從軍事上說，法軍的損失是四百一十五人陣亡與二千一百六十人受傷，多數集中在攻城的最後幾日與海上；從政治上說，這場勝仗在國內換來的是舊王朝的覆亡，新王朝在接收時才發現法軍控制的地盤不過是一條海岸線與幾座據點，之後還要打十四年，內陸的西邊更在阿卜杜勒卡迪爾手上另起一國。對卡面那門野砲而言，這場戰役是一份反面教材：可以拆成砲身、炮架同前車的輕砲，在斯泰勒利能反擊、能守灘頭，卻連城牆的一角都咬不下來；打穿皇帝堡的是隨艦運來的攻城重砲同海軍的攻城砲列，而它們之所以能在七月三日全部就位，靠的是一整支艦隊的運輸能力——野砲從來不是攻城的主宰，但沒有野砲守住灘頭，攻城重砲連卸船的地方都沒有。
resultEn: The result was that the French took the city of Algiers in twenty-one days and very far from taking Algeria. On 5 July Hussein Dey signed the capitulation at the villa of Raïs Hamidou at El Biar, providing for a French garrison while the Dey withdrew to Blida and kept his authority over the interior; on 9 July the French marched into the city, and the interior remained in the hands of the beys and the tribes, Ahmed Bey of Constantine continuing to resist until 1837. The way the gate was opened was not creditable: the defenders fired their magazines as they abandoned the fort, the central tower blew up, and behind the fort stood a small pyramid of severed heads for which the Dey had paid a bounty. Militarily the French lost four hundred and fifteen dead and two thousand one hundred and sixty wounded, most of them in the last days of the siege and at sea; politically the victory bought the old dynasty its fall at home, and the new dynasty discovered on taking over that the French held only a strip of coast and a handful of posts, and would have to fight on for fourteen years, while in the western interior Abd al-Qadir would raise a state of his own. As for the field gun on the card, this campaign is a lesson in reverse: a light piece that could be broken into barrel, carriage and limber could counter-attack at Staouéli and hold a bridgehead, yet it could not bite a single corner off the wall; what breached Fort de l'Empereur was the heavy siege train shipped out with the fleet together with the naval siege guns, and the reason those could all be emplaced on 3 July lay in the lift of a whole fleet. The field gun was never the master of a siege, but without the field gun holding the bridgehead the heavy guns would not even have had a beach on which to land.
